title: Augments+
description: This mod adds a custom armor augmentation system! +42 Custom Items & Creative tab!
body:
Better Augments is a vanilla-plus progression mod for Fabric 1.21.11 that introduces 40 late-game armor augments. Each armor piece can be equipped with one powerful passive upgrade, letting you build your gear around movement, survivability, utility, or combat.

Augments are divided by armor slot—helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots—and range from uncommon to epic rarity. All are crafted through expensive, endgame-focused recipes centered around Raw Augments and other high-tier materials.

To keep everything accessible in-game, /minecraft+ augments opens a custom guide showcasing every augment and its recipe, and all items are organized into a dedicated creative tab.

The mod also expands enchantment progression by:

Adding Infinity II and Infinity III
Allowing Infinity and Mending to work together
Letting Infinity III use tipped arrows when available
Enabling Smite and Bane of Arthropods to stack
